## Summary
- Add `CHANGELOG.md` with Sepo 0.1.0 release notes.
- Confirm `.agent/package.json` and `.agent/package-lock.json` already use the canonical package/runtime version `0.1.0`.
- Validate `0.1.0` against `.agent/docs/technical-details/versioning.md` as package SemVer with release tag `v0.1.0`.

## Tests
- Release-version parser check for `0.1.0`
- `npm --prefix .agent run build`
- `git diff --no-index --check /dev/null CHANGELOG.md`

No git tags, GitHub Releases, or package publications were created.

Closes #209
title: Prepare Sepo 0.1.0 release
